proposals.title: Promotion ready: learned weights beat the market out of sample

Largest weights: [('bias', 0.2496), ('member:gemini', 0.0), ('member:nvidia', 0.0), ('member:openrouter', 0.0)]. Promotion = the board's chance (or the panel's probability) uses the learned model. Architect decision.

proposals.title: Model input proven: H003 — wire it in as a shadow feature
proposals.body: research/runner.py accepted H003: SportyBet's closing Over 2.5 price knows something the model doesn't — lean the model's Over 2.5 toward it (evidence {'brier_model': 0.2429, 'gain': 0.0038, 'last_coef': 0.239, 'rows': 785, 'scored': 658, 'se': 0.00165, 'verdict': 'ADDS INFORMATION'}). Nothing consumes candidate features yet: build it as a model input in SHADOW (engine/inputs.py style), add it to engine/learned_weights.py and report walk-forward Brier / CLV. Promotion to the live model stays with the Architect.
